summary: Phase 1 SMMM ERP tested end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass (auth, RBAC, dashboard, clients CRUD, declarations grid + update + bulk, e-defter, cari + accrual idempotency, tasks, calendar, notifications, personel, audit, AI assistant). Frontend: login → dashboard KPIs (7) → clients search + add-dialog save → declarations grid (38 cells) → e-defter (31 items) → tasks (3) → cari run-accrual → calendar add-event → notifications (6) → assistant chat → personel add → audit list → theme toggle → Ctrl+K command palette all functional.

minor.issue: Cookie set with SameSite=None; Secure — works over HTTPS preview but will not work on plain http local dev. Non-blocking for preview.
allow_origins only includes FRONTEND_URL + localhost:3000; CORS_ORIGINS env var is defined in .env but not used in code.

issues: React warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Login)' — likely a navigate() called during render instead of useEffect.
Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle — accessibility warning. Wrap title with VisuallyHidden or add DialogTitle.

action_items: Fix Login setState-in-render warning (move navigation to useEffect on auth state).
Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) to all Radix dialogs to satisfy a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py imports emergentintegrations lazily inside the endpoint; OK but consider caching LlmChat.
run_accrual is idempotent (verified: 2nd run returns count=0 for same period).
CORS allow_origins ignores CORS_ORIGINS env var — dead configuration.
server.py is 683 lines — consider splitting into routers per resource for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Seeder auto-populated admin, 3 personel, 8 demo clients, declarations, transactions, tasks. Tests also created TEST_ prefixed clients/users/tasks (some intentionally left for verification).
